# Teeth Done in Turkey

> UK patient guide and coordination service for people researching dental treatment in Turkey, including veneers, implants, treatment costs, clinic selection, travel and aftercare.

Teeth Done in Turkey is a UK-focused advisory and patient-coordination service. It is not a dental clinic or registered healthcare provider. We help patients research treatment options and coordinate enquiries with dental providers in Turkey. Treatment availability, provider credentials, prices, finance terms, materials, guarantees and clinical suitability must be confirmed for the individual patient before booking. All published prices are indicative rather than guaranteed quotes. Contact: hello@teethdoneinturkey.co.uk, WhatsApp +90 535 399 8999.

## Entity

- **Legal type**: UK dental tourism advisory and booking service
- **Not**: a dental clinic; a healthcare provider; a GDC-registered dental practice
- **Geographic scope**: UK patients researching dental treatment in Turkey
- **Role**: information, enquiry handling and patient coordination; clinical treatment is provided by independent dental providers
- **Verification rule**: provider credentials, materials, guarantees, prices and finance terms must be confirmed before being presented as current facts
- **Verified medical reviewer**: [Dt. Mustafa Akça](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/medical-reviewers/mustafa-akca) — reviewer attribution is used only on pages with a recorded completed review
- **Currency**: GBP — published prices are indicative and not guaranteed quotes

## Data & Methodology

- [Turkey Dental Price Index 2026](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/turkey-dental-price-index): The site's single price dataset — indicative partner-clinic list prices in GBP for implants, full-arch, crowns, veneers and packages, against typical UK private ranges. Every price on the site comes from this dataset. Prices last verified June 2026. Downloads: [CSV](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/turkey-dental-price-index/data.csv), [JSON](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/turkey-dental-price-index/data.json).
- [Price & Data Methodology](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/methodology): Data sources, what published prices include and exclude, how percentage differences are calculated (1 − Turkey price ÷ UK price), update policy and limitations.
- **Turkey Treatment Total Cost** (defined on the methodology page): Turkey Treatment Total Cost = Clinical Cost + Prosthetic Cost + Travel Cost + Follow-up Risk Allowance. Published treatment prices cover the clinical and prosthetic parts; packages also cover hotel and transfers; flights and the follow-up allowance are never included.

## Editorial & Medical Standards

- [Editorial & Medical Review Policy](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/editorial-policy): How health and price information on this site is written, reviewed, verified and maintained. Reviewer identities or credentials should be stated only where the review has actually occurred and can be substantiated.

- [Dental Implants Turkey](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/treatments/dental-implants-turkey): How to arrange implant treatment through the service. Implant + crown from £250 (Osstem), £430 (Medentika), £930 (Straumann) (indicative; last verified June 2026) vs £2,000–£4,500 UK private.
- [All-on-4 Turkey](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/treatments/all-on-4-turkey): Full-arch restoration on 4 implants from £4,500 per arch (indicative; includes hotel and airport transfers), 5–7 days.
- [All-on-6 Turkey](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/treatments/all-on-6-turkey): Full-arch restoration on 6 implants from £5,600 all-inclusive (indicative; includes hotel and airport transfers).

## Prices & Cost Guides

- [Turkey Teeth Cost 2026](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/prices/turkey-teeth-cost): Master price guide — implants from £250, veneers from £190/tooth, packages from £2,800, with UK comparison and finance options. Prices last verified June 2026; individual quotes via free consultation.
- [Veneers Turkey Cost](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/prices/veneers-turkey-cost): Veneer price breakdown by material (E-max, zirconia, composite).
- [Dental Implants Turkey Cost](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/prices/dental-implants-turkey-cost): Canonical answer to "how much do dental implants cost in Turkey". Implant + crown from £250 (Osstem), £430 (Medentika), £930 (Straumann); bone graft from £200; All-on-4 from £4,500 and All-on-6 from £5,600 per arch incl. hotel and transfers. Most implant treatment needs two trips 3–6 months apart; flights never included. Last verified June 2026.
- [All-on-6 Package](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/prices/all-on-6-dental-implants-turkey-package): £5,600 all-inclusive package breakdown (implants, hotel, transfers).
- [Hollywood Smile Package](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/prices/hollywood-smile-turkey-package): 20 zirconia crowns from £2,800 / 24 crowns from £3,100, all-inclusive.
- [Price Calculator](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/price-calculator): Interactive tool to estimate treatment cost and UK savings.

## Affordability & Access Guides (UK NHS access, emergency dental, treatment costs)

- [Can't Afford Dental Treatment in the UK?](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/cant-afford-dental-treatment-uk): NHS charges, private costs, payment plans, dental finance and treatment abroad, in decision order. Hub for the full affordability cluster.
- [Can't Find an NHS Dentist? Step-by-Step Options](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/no-nhs-dentist-what-to-do): NHS 111 dental referral, NHS emergency dental services, Community Dental Services (CDS), dental schools, and realistic alternatives for UK patients who cannot find an NHS practice accepting patients. NHS band charges: Band 1 £27.90, Band 2 £76.60, Band 3 £306.80 (England, April 2026, source: NHS England). Reviewed per [editorial methodology](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/editorial-policy).
- [Can't Afford a Root Canal UK?](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/cant-afford-root-canal-uk): Root canal on the NHS costs £76.60 (Band 2, England, April 2026). Private costs £500–£1,500 (front tooth to molar) plus £800–£1,000 crown. Root canal + crown in Turkey: £330–£580 (indicative; last verified June 2026). Root canal vs extraction comparison, risks of delay, payment plans. Reviewed per [editorial methodology](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/editorial-policy).
- [Tooth Abscess Can't Afford a Dentist?](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/tooth-abscess-cant-afford-dentist): YMYL emergency guide. Call NHS 111 (dial 111) if you cannot access a dentist — free referral to NHS emergency dental service. Go to A&E or call 999 for facial swelling, fever above 38°C, difficulty swallowing/breathing. Antibiotics reduce infection but do not resolve an abscess — dental treatment is required. Reviewed per [editorial methodology](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/editorial-policy).
- [Severe Toothache Can't Afford a Dentist?](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/guides/severe-toothache-cant-afford-dentist): NHS 111 provides 24/7 dental referral at no upfront cost. Common causes: pulpitis, abscess, cracked tooth, lost filling. Temporary relief measures (ibuprofen, clove oil, cold compress) reduce pain but are not a substitute for treatment. A&E escalation criteria included. Reviewed per [editorial methodology](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/editorial-policy).

- [Full Mouth Dental Implants Turkey Cost](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/blog/full-mouth-implants-uk-vs-turkey): All-on-4 both arches £8,000–£11,000 and All-on-6 £10,000–£14,000 in Turkey vs £24,000–£44,000 in the UK (indicative; last verified June 2026). Stage-by-stage costs, what the package includes, monthly payment example.
- [Hollywood Smile Cost: UK vs Turkey](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/blog/hollywood-smile-uk-vs-turkey): 20 zirconia crowns from £2,800 in Turkey vs £15,000+ UK.

- [Single Tooth Implant Cost](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/blog/single-tooth-implant-turkey-cost): One implant, abutment and crown from £250 (Osstem) to £930 (Straumann), plus an all-in example including two trips' travel; when a UK implant makes more sense.
- [Why Is Dental Care Cheaper in Turkey?](https://www.teethdoneinturkey.co.uk/blog/why-are-dental-treatments-cheaper-in-turkey): Lower overheads, not lower quality — the structural reasons for the price gap.
